content.short: Rug Rumble is a Monad game where players run through doors to multiply MON before cashing out.
content.description: Rug Rumble is a cash-out game on Monad in which the multiplier grows the further a player goes and everything is lost if they go too far. The mechanic is old and effective, and its appeal rests entirely on the player believing they will stop in time.
content.meta: A cash-out game on Monad where the multiplier grows until the player goes one door too far.
